description: This file declares functions and includes for IPC (Inter-Process Communication) mechanisms related to a filesystem monitor daemon in a git-related project. It defines methods to check support, get IPC paths, determine daemon state, and communicate via simple-ipc.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__is_supported
methods.description: Checks if the built-in file system monitor daemon is supported on the current platform.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__get_path
methods.description: Returns the IPC path or socket for the daemon, or NULL if unsupported.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__get_state
methods.description: Determines whether the daemon is active/listening.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__send_query
methods.description: Connects to the daemon via IPC and requests changed files since a token.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__send_command
methods.description: Sends a command verb to the daemon via IPC.
